\subsection{Numbered equation list}
Every equation in the document, grouped by section, in compact form. The full card for each one follows in its section.
\paragraph{Section A}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[A.1] General balance: $\frac{d}{dt}\int_V\rho\psi\,dV+\oint_S\rho\psi\,\mathbf u\cdot\mathbf n\,dS=-\oint_S\mathbf j_\psi\cdot\mathbf n\,dS+\int_V\dot s_\psi\,dV$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.2] Total mass: $dM/dt=\sum_{in}\dot m-\sum_{out}\dot m$, SS gives $\sum_{in}\dot m=\sum_{out}\dot m$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.3] Component: $dn_i/dt=\sum_{in}F_i-\sum_{out}F_i+\int_VR_i\,dV$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.4] Source term: $R_i=\sum_j\nu_{ij}r_j$; catalytic form $R_i=\rho_B\sum_j\nu_{ij}\eta_j^{cat}r_j$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.5] Elements: $\sum_ia_{ki}(F_{i,out}-F_{i,in})=0$, requires $\mathbf a\boldsymbol\nu=0$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.6] Independent reactions: $N_r=N_s-\mathrm{rank}(\mathbf a)$. Reformer $5-3=2$, so $K_3=K_1K_2$. MEA $9-4=5$ with charge as a row {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.7] First law: $dE/dt=\dot Q-\dot W_{sh}+\sum_{in}\dot m(h+u^2/2+gz)-\sum_{out}\dot m(h+u^2/2+gz)$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.8] Enthalpy balance: $\sum_{out}F_ih_i-\sum_{in}F_ih_i=\dot Q-\dot W_{sh}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.9] Species enthalpy: $h_i(T)=\Delta_fh_i^\circ+\int_{T_{ref}}^Tc_{p,i}dT$, Shomate $c_{p,i}=A+Bt+Ct^2+Dt^3+E_S/t^2$, $t=T/1000$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[A.10] Hess: $\Delta_rh_j(T)=\sum_i\nu_{ij}h_i(T)$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.11] Momentum, channel: $dp/dz=-\rho u\,du/dz-(f_D/D)\rho u^2/2-\rho g\sin\theta$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.12] Packed bed, Ergun: $-dp/dz=\frac{G}{\rho D_p}\frac{1-\varepsilon_b}{\varepsilon_b^3}\left[\frac{150(1-\varepsilon_b)\mu}{D_p}+1.75G\right]$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[A.13] Plug-flow reduction: $dF_i/dz=A_cR_i$; $\sum_iF_ic_{p,i}\,dT/dz=\dot q'+A_c\sum_j(-\Delta_rh_j)r_j$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.14] Gas closure: $p_i=y_ip$, $c=p/(ZRT)$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[A.15] Residuals: $\epsilon_m$, $\epsilon_k$, $\epsilon_E$ relative to inlet flow. Limit $10^{-8}$ per unit, $10^{-6}$ flowsheet {\footnotesize [F]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section B}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[B.1] Helium density: $\rho=48.14(P/T)/(1+0.4446P/T^{1.2})$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.2] $c_p=5195$, $c_v=3117$ J/kg/K, $\kappa=1.6667$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.3] Viscosity: $\mu=3.674\times10^{-7}T^{0.7}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.4] Conductivity: $k=2.682\times10^{-3}(1+1.123\times10^{-3}P)T^{0.71(1-2\times10^{-4}P)}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.5] Reactor balance: $\dot Q_R-\dot Q_{ves}=\dot m_pc_p(T_{ROT}-T_{RI})$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[B.6] Circulator rise: $T_{RI}=T_{h,out}+\dot W_p/(\dot m_pc_p)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[B.7] Primary: $\dot Q_p=\dot m_pc_p(T_{ROT}-T_{h,out})$, $T_{h,out}\ge T_{s,ret}+\Delta T_{app}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[B.8] Secondary: $\dot Q_s=\dot m_sc_p(T_{s,sup}-T_{s,ret})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[B.9] Flow need: $\dot m_s=\dot Q_{proc}/(c_p\Delta T_s)$, $\dot m_p=\dot Q_R/[c_p(T_{ROT}-T_{s,ret}-\Delta T_{app})]$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[B.10] Compression: $\dot W=\dot mc_pT_1[(1+\Delta p/p)^{(\kappa-1)/\kappa}-1]/\eta_{is}$, exponent 0.4 {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[B.11] Budget: 7.0 MPa, $\Delta p_s=200$ kPa, $\Delta p_p=150$ kPa. Low, high and 5.15 MPa sets {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[B.12] Electric draw: $E_{circ}=(\dot W_s+\dot W_p)/\eta_m$, $\eta_m=0.90$ {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[B.13] Vessel loss: $\dot Q_{ves}=0.81(\dot Q_R/30)^{2/3}$ MW; high case $0.027\dot Q_R$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.14] Duct loss: $\dot Q_{duct}=0.45(\dot m_s/78.49)^{1/2}$ MW at 90 m, 3.12 MW at 500 m {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.15] IHX loss: $\dot Q_{ihx}=f_{ihx}(\dot Q_{proc}+\dot Q_{rec})$, $f_{ihx}=0.008$, range 0 to 0.0458 {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.16] Available heat: $\dot Q_{av}=\dot Q_R+\dot W_s+\dot W_p-\dot Q_{ves}-\dot Q_{ihx}-\dot Q_{duct}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[B.17] Efficiency: $\eta_{pc}=0.397$; alternative $0.475=0.66(1-T_c/T_h)$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.18] Power branch: $E=\eta_{pc}\dot Q_{pc}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[B.19] Extraction: $w=\min(E,r_w\dot Q_{gap})$, $\dot Q_{br}=\dot Q_{gap}+w+(E-w)/\eta_{pc}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[B.20] Allocation: $\dot Q_R=\dot Q_{proc}+\dot Q_{rec}+\dot Q_{ihx}+\dot Q_{duct}+\dot Q_{ves}+\dot Q_{br}-\dot W_s-\dot W_p$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[B.21] Margin: $\dot Q_{spare}=\dot Q_{rated}-\dot Q_R$. No revenue credited {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[B.22] INL inlet fit: $T_{RI}=0.8205T_{ROT}-242.68$ (C) {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[B.23] INL excess heat: $\dot Q_{ex}=\dot m_sc_p(T_{s,ret}-T_{s,ideal})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section C}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[C.1] Hot side: $\dot Q_h=\dot m_pc_p(T_{h,in}-T_{h,out})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.2] Cold side: $\dot Q_c=\dot m_sc_p(T_{c,out}-T_{c,in})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.3] Closure: $\dot Q_h=\dot Q_c+\dot Q_{ihx}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.4] Network: $\frac1{UA}=\frac1{h_{fi}A_i}+\frac{R_{f,i}}{A_i}+\frac{\ln(d_o/d_i)}{2\pi k_wLN_t}+\frac{R_{f,o}}{A_o}+\frac1{h_{fo}A_o}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.5] Overall coefficient: $U_o=(UA)/A_o$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.6] Nusselt: tube side Tochio Eq 8, shell side Eq 5 and 6 with $C_0$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[C.7] LMTD: $\Delta T_{lm}=(\Delta T_1-\Delta T_2)/\ln(\Delta T_1/\Delta T_2)$, derived from $d\dot Q=U\Delta T\,dA$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.8] Balanced limit: $\Delta T_{lm}\to\Delta T$ as $\Delta T_1\to\Delta T_2$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.9] Effectiveness: $\varepsilon_{HX}=\dot Q/[C_{min}(T_{h,in}-T_{c,in})]$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.10] $NTU=UA/C_{min}$, $C^*=C_{min}/C_{max}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.11] Counterflow: $\varepsilon_{HX}=\frac{1-e^{-NTU(1-C^*)}}{1-C^*e^{-NTU(1-C^*)}}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.12] Balanced: $\varepsilon_{HX}=NTU/(1+NTU)$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.13] Area: $A=\dot Q/(U\Delta T_{lm})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[C.14] Module anchor: $UA_{mod}=UA/N_{mod}$, HTTR measured 85 kW/K {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[C.15] Unbalanced option: choose $T_{h,out}$, get $\dot m_p$, cold end, LMTD, UA {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[C.16] Tube friction: $\Delta p=f_D(L/D)\rho u^2/2$, $f_D=0.3164Re^{-1/4}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[C.17] Cascade: $T_{s,sup}=T_{ROT}-\Delta T_{app}-\Delta T_{duct}$ {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[C.18] Constraints: $T_{s,sup}-T_{ref,out}\ge10$ K, tube $\le955$ C, tube $\Delta p\le0.3$ MPa {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[C.19] Pressure sign: $p_s\ge p_p+0.1$ MPa in HTTR. Project sign left to the safety case {\footnotesize [F]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section D}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[D.1] Reaction I: $\mathrm{CH_4+H_2O\rightleftharpoons CO+3H_2}$, $+206.1$ kJ/mol {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.2] Reaction II, shift: $\mathrm{CO+H_2O\rightleftharpoons CO_2+H_2}$, $-41.15$ kJ/mol {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.3] Reaction III: $\mathrm{CH_4+2H_2O\rightleftharpoons CO_2+4H_2}$, $+164.9$ kJ/mol, equal to I + II {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.4] Heavier gas: $\mathrm{C_nH_m+nH_2O\to nCO+(n+m/2)H_2}$ taken to completion at tube inlet {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.5] Feed ratio: $S/C=F_{H_2O}/F_C$, 3.0 {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[D.6] Extents, per mole CH4 fed: CH4 $1-x_1$; CO $x_1-x_2$; CO2 $\xi_{CO_2}+x_2$; H2 $\xi_{H_2}+3x_1+x_2$; H2O $S_C-x_1-x_2$; total $\Sigma_0+2x_1$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.7] $K_1(T)=1.198\times10^{13}\exp(-26830/T)$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.8] $K_2(T)=1.767\times10^{-2}\exp(4400/T)$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.9] $K_3=K_1K_2$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.10] Quotients: $Q_1=p_{H_2}^3p_{CO}/(p_{CH_4}p_{H_2O})$, $Q_2=p_{H_2}p_{CO_2}/(p_{CO}p_{H_2O})$, $Q_3=Q_1Q_2$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.11] Equilibrium: solve $Q_1(x)=K_1(T)$, $Q_2(x)=K_2(T)$ at exit $T$, $p$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.12] Consistency: $d\ln K/d(1/T)=-\Delta_rh/R$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.13] Rates: $k_i=A(k_i)\exp(-E_{a,i}/RT)$; $A=4.225\times10^{15}$, $1.955\times10^{6}$, $1.020\times10^{15}$; $E_a=240.1$, $67.13$, $243.9$ kJ/mol {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.14] Adsorption: $K_j=A_j\exp(-\Delta H_j/RT)$; $K_{CO}$ 8.23e-5, $-70.65$; $K_{H_2}$ 6.12e-9, $-82.90$; $K_{CH_4}$ 6.65e-4, $-38.28$; $K_{H_2O}$ 1.77e5, $+88.68$ kJ/mol {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.15] $DEN=1+K_{CO}p_{CO}+K_{H_2}p_{H_2}+K_{CH_4}p_{CH_4}+K_{H_2O}p_{H_2O}/p_{H_2}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.16] $r_1=(k_1/p_{H_2}^{2.5})(p_{CH_4}p_{H_2O}-p_{H_2}^3p_{CO}/K_1)/DEN^2$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.17] $r_2=(k_2/p_{H_2})(p_{CO}p_{H_2O}-p_{H_2}p_{CO_2}/K_2)/DEN^2$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.18] $r_3=(k_3/p_{H_2}^{3.5})(p_{CH_4}p_{H_2O}^2-p_{H_2}^4p_{CO_2}/K_3)/DEN^2$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.19] Species: $r_{CO}=r_1-r_2$, $r_{CO_2}=r_2+r_3$, $r_{CH_4}=r_1+r_3$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.20] Effectiveness: $\eta_j^{cat}=\int\rho_sr_j\,dV/(\rho_sr_j^sV_p)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.21] Lumped activity: $\eta_1^{cat}=\eta_2^{cat}=\eta_3^{cat}=a_{cat}$, fitted on JAERI A-2 only {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.22] Continuity: $dx_{CH_4}/dz=(\Omega\rho_B/F^0_{CH_4})(\eta_1r_1+\eta_3r_3)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.23] Continuity: $dx_{CO_2}/dz=(\Omega\rho_B/F^0_{CH_4})(\eta_2r_2+\eta_3r_3)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.24] Partial pressures from D.6: $p_i=py_i$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.25] Energy: $c_p\rho_gu_s\,dT/dz=\rho_B\sum_j(-\Delta_rh_j)\eta_jr_j+(4U/d_i)(T_w-T)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.26] Momentum: A.12 {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.27] Wall: $1/U=1/h_{fi}+R_f+t_w/k_w+(A_i/A_o)/h_{fo}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.28] Helium side: $\dot m_{He}c_p\,dT_{He}/dz=\pm\pi d_iN_tU(T_{He}-T)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.29] Finned annulus: $Nu=0.039Re^{0.87}Pr^{0.4}(S_f/D_e)^{0.4}(H_f/D_e)^{-0.19}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.30] Plain annulus: $Nu=0.205Re^{0.603}Pr^{0.33}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.31] Process side: $h_w=0.4(k_g/D_p)(2.58Re^{1/3}Pr^{1/3}+0.094Re^{0.8}Pr^{0.4})$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.32] Radiation: $q=\sigma\varepsilon_{r,a}\varepsilon_{r,b}\pi d_o(T_a^4-T_b^4)/A_{sh}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[D.33] Performance: $X_{CH_4}=x_1$ at exit; $Y_{H_2}=F_{H_2,out}/F_{CH_4,in}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[D.34] Tube duty: $\dot Q_{tube}=\sum F_ih_i\rvert_{out}-\sum F_ih_i\rvert_{in}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.35] Tube count: $N_t=\dot Q_{tube}/(\pi d_oL\,q'')$, $q''=40$ to 60 kW/m2 {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[D.36] Hot end: $\Delta T_{hot}=T_{s,sup}-T_{ref,out}=29$ K. Sensitivity 825 C, 800 C {\footnotesize [F]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section E}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[E.1] CO conversion: $X_{CO}=(F_{CO,in}-F_{CO,out})/F_{CO,in}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[E.2] Species: $F_i=F_{i,in}+\nu_i\xi$ with $\nu$ for D.2 {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[E.3] Constraint: $Q_2(T_{out})\le K_2(T_{out})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[E.4] Approach: $Q_2(T_{out})=K_2(T_{out}+\Delta T_{eq})$, $\Delta T_{eq}=10$ K {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[E.5] Adiabatic bed: $\sum F_ih_i\rvert_{out}=\sum F_ih_i\rvert_{in}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[E.6] Heat release: $\dot Q_{WGS}=\xi(-\Delta_rh_2)$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[E.7] HTS rate: $dp_{CO}/dt=-k(p_{CO}-p_{CO,eq})$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[E.8] Integrated: $k=S_v\ln[1/(1-C/C_e)]$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[E.9] $k(T)$: interpolate Table 1, 310 to 450 C, 16 to 31 bar {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[E.10] Catalyst volume: $V_{cat}=(\dot V/k)\ln[1/(1-C/C_e)]$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[E.11] Profile: $\sum F_ic_{p,i}\,dT/d\xi=-\Delta_rh_2$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[E.12] Drop: fixed 17 psi across each bed, Ergun as check {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[E.13] Steam ratio: $S/DG=F_{H_2O}/\sum_{dry}F_i$ {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[E.14] Window: HTS inlet $\ge$ 600 F; LTS inlet $\ge$ 375 F and 27 F above dew {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[E.15] LTS model: E.4 only. No rate law [M4] {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[E.16] Listed, not used: Kraussler power law, Table 3 orders {\footnotesize [E]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section F}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[F.1] Sensible: $\dot Q=\sum_iF_i[h_i(T_1)-h_i(T_2)]$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[F.2] Train: sum over HPS-GEN1, EX1, EX2, EX3, EX4, KO-DRM-1 {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[F.3] Dew point: $y_{H_2O}p=p_{sat}(T_{dp})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[F.4] Saturation: IAPWS-IF97 via seuif97 {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[F.5] Water VLE: $y_wp=x_w\gamma_wp_{sat}(T)$, $x_w\approx1$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[F.6] Dissolved gas: $x_{CO_2}=y_{CO_2}p/H_{CO_2}$, Aronu Eq 17 {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[F.7] Flash: $\sum_iz_i(K_i-1)/[1+V(K_i-1)]=0$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[F.8] Mass: $F=V+L$, $Fz_i=Vy_i+Lx_i$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[F.9] Energy: $\dot Q=Vh_V+Lh_L-Fh_F$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[F.10] Condensate split: $L=L_{ret}+L_{treat}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[F.11] Heat above $T_{min}$: $\dot Q(T_{min})=\int_{T_{min}}^{149\,C}\dot C\,dT+\dot m_{cond}\Delta h_{vap}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[F.12] CO2 lost in condensate, kept outside the ledger {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[F.13] Absorber feed: dry composition after KO, $y_{CO_2}$, $y_{CO}$, $y_{CH_4}$, $y_{H_2}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section G}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[G.1] Reactions: $\mathrm{2H_2O\rightleftharpoons H_3O^++OH^-}$; $\mathrm{2H_2O+CO_2\rightleftharpoons H_3O^++HCO_3^-}$; $\mathrm{H_2O+HCO_3^-\rightleftharpoons H_3O^++CO_3^{2-}}$; $\mathrm{H_2O+MEAH^+\rightleftharpoons H_3O^++MEA}$; $\mathrm{H_2O+MEACOO^-\rightleftharpoons MEA+HCO_3^-}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.2] $\ln K$ or $\ln H=C_1+C_2/T+C_3\ln T+C_4T$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[G.3] Chemical potential: $\mu_i=\mu_i^\circ(T)+RT\ln(\gamma_ix_i)$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.4] $RT\ln K_j=-\sum_i\nu_{ij}\mu_i^\circ$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.5] Equilibrium: $\ln K_j=\sum_i\nu_{ij}\ln(\gamma_ix_i)$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.6] Standard states: H2O and MEA pure; solutes $\gamma_i^*=\gamma_i/\gamma_i^\infty$ in water {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.7] Hidden convention: $\ln K_{MEA,eff}=\ln K_{MEA}+\ln\gamma_{MEA}^\infty$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[G.8] MEA balance: $n_{MEA}+n_{MEAH^+}+n_{MEACOO^-}=n^0$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.9] Carbon: $n_{CO_2}+n_{HCO_3^-}+n_{CO_3^{2-}}+n_{MEACOO^-}=\alpha n^0$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.10] Hydrogen element balance over all nine species {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.11] Electroneutrality: $n_{H_3O^+}+n_{MEAH^+}=n_{OH^-}+n_{HCO_3^-}+2n_{CO_3^{2-}}+n_{MEACOO^-}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.12] Loading: $\alpha=$ total CO2 / total MEA {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.13] $\ln\gamma_i=\ln\gamma_i^C+\ln\gamma_i^R+\ln\gamma_i^{DH}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.14] Combinatorial: $\ln\gamma_i^C=\ln(\phi_i/x_i)+1-\phi_i/x_i-(z/2)q_i[\ln(\phi_i/\theta_i)+1-\phi_i/\theta_i]$, $z=10$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.15] Residual: $\ln\gamma_i^R=q_i[1-\ln\sum_k\theta_k\psi_{ki}-\sum_k\theta_k\psi_{ik}/\sum_l\theta_l\psi_{lk}]$, $\psi_{ki}=\exp[-(u_{ki}-u_{ii})/T]$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.16] $u_{ki}=u^0_{ki}+u^T_{ki}(T-298.15)$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[G.17] Debye-Hueckel: $\ln\gamma_i^{DH}=-z_i^2A\sqrt I/(1+b\sqrt I)$, water term $(2/3)M_wAI^{3/2}\sigma(b\sqrt I)$, $b=1.5$, $A(T)=1.131+1.335\times10^{-3}t+1.164\times10^{-5}t^2$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.18] Ionic strength: $I=\tfrac12\sum_im_iz_i^2$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.19] CO2 VLE: $\varphi_{CO_2}y_{CO_2}p=\gamma^*_{CO_2}x_{CO_2}H\exp[v^\infty(p-p_s)/RT]$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.20] H2O and MEA VLE: $\varphi_iy_ip=\gamma_ix_ip_i^s\varphi_i^s\exp[v_i(p-p_i^s)/RT]$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.21] Vapour: SRK fugacity {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[G.22] Henry in water: $H_w=2.82\times10^6\exp(-2044/T)$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[G.23] N2O analogy: $H_{app}=H_{N_2O}H_{w,CO_2}/H_{w,N_2O}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[G.24] Heat of absorption: $\Delta h_{abs}=-R(\partial\ln p^*_{CO_2}/\partial(1/T))_x$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[G.25] Solvent heat capacity: $c_{p,s}=3.6$ kJ/kg/K {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[G.26] Density (Weiland): $V=\sum_ix_iV_i+x_Mx_WV^*$, $V_M=61.08/(aT^2+bT+c)$, $V_{CO_2}=0.04747$ mL/mol {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[G.27] Viscosity (Weiland): $\mu=\mu_w\exp\{(21.186\Omega+2373)[\alpha(0.01015\Omega+0.0093T-2.2589)+1]\Omega/T^2\}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[G.28] Diffusivity: $D_w=2.35\times10^{-6}\exp(-2119/T)$, $D_l=D_w(\mu_w/\mu)^{0.8}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[G.29] Free MEA: $n_{MEA}/n^0$ from G.5 to G.11 {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[G.30] Comparator: Dugas Eq 5.26 {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[G.31] Plant point: $\alpha^*(p_{CO_2},T)$, 0.741 at 378 kPa, 40 C {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[G.32] Guards: $T$ 313 to 393 K, $\alpha\le0.50$ in columns, $p_{CO_2}\le10$ bar {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[G.33] Table $p^*(T,\alpha)$ for column calls, bilinear in $\ln p$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section H}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[H.1] Gas film: $N_{CO_2}=k_G(p_{CO_2}-p_i)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.2] Liquid film: $N_{CO_2}=Ek_L^\circ(p_i-p^*)/H$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.3] Interface: $p_i=HC_i$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[H.4] Overall: $N_{CO_2}=K_G(p_{CO_2}-p^*)$, $1/K_G=1/k_G+H/(Ek_L^\circ)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.5] $\log_{10}k_2=10.99-2152/T$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[H.6] $M=D_lk_2C_B/(k_L^\circ)^2$, $E_1=\sqrt M/\tanh\sqrt M$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.7] $E_\infty=1+C_BD_B/(bD_lC_i)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.8] Wellek: $E=1+1/[(1/(E_\infty-1))^{1.35}+(1/(E_1-1))^{1.35}]^{1/1.35}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.9] $H=10^{5.3-0.035C_{MEA}-1140/T}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[H.10] $k_L=2(D_LC_EU_L/\pi S)^{1/2}$, $C_E=0.9$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[H.11] $k_G=0.054(D_G/S)[(U_L+U_G)\rho_GS/\mu_G]^{0.8}(\mu_G/D_G\rho_G)^{0.33}$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[H.12] Area, central: Billet and Schultes $a_e/a=C_h(U_L\rho_L/a\mu_L)^{0.25}(U_L^2a/g)^{0.1}\times0.85$, $Re_L\ge5$, $C_h=0.554$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[H.13] Area, alternatives: Rocha with $F_{SE}=0.25$ or 0.35, Wang, Gualito {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[H.14] Gas: $dG/dz=-(N_{CO_2}+N_{H_2O})aA_c$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.15] $dy_{CO_2}/dz=[N_{CO_2}aA_c(y_{CO_2}-1)+N_{H_2O}y_{CO_2}aA_c]/G$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.16] $dy_{H_2O}/dz=[N_{H_2O}aA_c(y_{H_2O}-1)+N_{CO_2}y_{H_2O}aA_c]/G$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.17] $dL/dz=-N_{H_2O}aA_c$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.18] $dX_{CO_2}/dz=(N_{H_2O}X_{CO_2}-N_{CO_2})aA_c/L$; $dX_{H_2O}/dz=N_{H_2O}(X_{H_2O}-1)aA_c/L$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.19] $dT_G/dz=-qaA_c/(Gc_{p,G})$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.20] $dT_L/dz$: terms in $q$, $N_{CO_2}H_{CO_2}+N_{H_2O}H_{H_2O}$ and $(N_{CO_2}c_{p,CO_2}+N_{H_2O}c_{p,H_2O})(T_L-T_G)$, all over $Lc_{p,L}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.21] Heat flux: $q=h(T_G-T_L)$, $h=k_Gc_G\,c_{p,G}(Sc/Pr)^{2/3}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.22] Water flux: $N_{H_2O}=k_{G,H_2O}(p_{H_2O}-p^*_{H_2O})$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.23] Drop: $\Delta p/Z=(\Delta p/Z)_{ref}(F/F_{ref})^2$, $F=u_G\sqrt{\rho_G}$ {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[H.24] Grid: $N$ finite volumes, upwind in each phase {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.25] Boundary: gas in at bottom, liquid in at top {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.26] Solve: damped Newton on the banded system, $\lVert res\rVert_\infty<10^{-8}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.27] Per-pass: $\eta_{pp}=(y_{in}n_{in}-y_{out}n_{out})/(y_{in}n_{in})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[H.28] Solvent: $\dot m_{solv}=\dot n_{CO_2}M_{MEA}/[w(\alpha_{rich}-\alpha_{lean})]$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[H.29] Diameter from liquid load, 40 to 100 m3/m2/h {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[H.30] Co-absorption: zero central. Reference: aMDEA 0.056\% H2, 0.137\% CH4 {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[H.31] Listed, not used: Isa index $f$, Eq 42 {\footnotesize [E]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section I}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[I.1] CO2 balance: $\dot n_{CO_2}=\dot n_{MEA}(\alpha_{rich}-\alpha_{lean})$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.2] Desorption driving force: H.4 with sign reversed {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[I.3] Equilibrium stage: $y_{CO_2}p=p^*(T,\alpha)$ on each of $N$ stages {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[I.4] Rich-end pinch: $n_{H_2O}/n_{CO_2}=(p-p^*_{CO_2})/p^*_{CO_2}$ at top {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[I.5] Lean-end: $T_{reb}$ solves $p^*_{CO_2}+p^*_{H_2O}+p^*_{MEA}=p_{strip}$ at $\alpha_{lean}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.6] Reboiler: $\dot Q_{reb}=\sum_{out}\dot nh-\sum_{in}\dot nh$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.7] Condenser: $\dot Q_{cond}=\dot Q_{H_2O}+\dot Q_{steam}+\dot Q_{CO_2}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.8] Reflux: condensate returned equals water in overhead at $T_{cond}$ less vent water {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.9] Circulation: H.28 {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.10] Rich-lean exchanger: $\dot m_rc_p(T_{r,out}-T_{r,in})=\dot m_lc_p(T_{l,in}-T_{l,out})$, approach 10 K {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.11] Steam: $\dot m_{st}=\dot Q_{reb}/\Delta h_{cond}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.12] SRD: $SRD=\dot Q_{reb}/\dot m_{CO_2}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.13] Split: $SRD=q_{des}+q_{sens}+q_{strip}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[I.14] Carried: 3.8, range 3.4 to 4.2 {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[I.15] Stripping intensity: $RD\cdot3600/\dot m_{rich}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.16] Reboiler area: $RD=UA_r\Delta T_{LMTD}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[I.17] Source temperature: $T_{source}\ge T_{reb}+\Delta T_{min}$, steam near 145 to 153 C {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[I.18] Listed, not carried: interheat, total heat unchanged, 3.77 GJ/t {\footnotesize [F]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section J}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[J.1] Scale: $s=\dot m_{H_2,B}/\dot m_{H_2,A}=8988/13154$ {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[J.2] $\dot m=\rho_N\dot V_N$, $\rho_N=0.08988$ kg/Nm3 {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.3] Annual: $M_{H_2}=\dot mt_h$, $t_h=8760f_{av}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.4] Gas: 1 MMSCFD = $10^6/(379.49\cdot24)$ lbmol/h {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.5] Feed carbon: $F_C=1.05379\,\dot n_{NG}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.6] Split: $\phi_c=F_{CO_2,abs}/T_C=0.775$, range 0.76 to 0.79 {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.7] INL fraction: $T_6=F_{cap,6}/(\eta_{Sel}\phi_c)$, $G_6=T_6-F_{cap,6}-P$, $f_r=(T_6-F_C)/G_6$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.8] Tube carbon: $T_C=(F_C-f_rP)/[1-f_r(1-\eta_{pp}\phi_c)]$, from $T_C=F_C+f_rG$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.9] Captured: $C=\eta_{pp}\phi_cT_C$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.10] Tail gas: $G=T_C-C-P$; recycled $f_rG$; burned $(1-f_r)G$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.11] Closure: $F_C=C+(1-f_r)G+P$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.12] PSA block, unsimulated: $F_{H_2,prod}=\xi_{PSA}F_{H_2,in}$, $\xi_{PSA}=0.88$; reject crosses the boundary (project decision) {\footnotesize [X]}
\item[J.13] Stream ledger: reformer syngas, H2-rich gas after MEA, product after PSA, recovery, annual H2, each a separate row {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.14] Process heat: $\dot Q_{proc}=176.8\,s$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.15] Slip heat: $\dot Q_{rec}=\Delta F_{slip}c_{p,CO_2}\Delta T$, 50 J/mol/K, 571 K {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.16] Reboiler: $\dot Q_{reb}=\dot m_{CO_2}SRD$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.17] Stack: freed Selexol $\dot Q_{Sel}$, export $\dot Q_{exp}$, syngas above 130 C, in that order {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.18] Gap: $\dot Q_{gap}=\max(0,\dot Q_{reb}-\dot Q_{stack})$. Unmet thermal demand if the reactor cannot cover it {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.19] Rows: reforming, PSA, steam, cooling, water scaled from Table 2. Selexol row removed {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.20] Lean pump: $E=\dot m_{solv}(p_{abs}-p_{strip})/(\rho\eta_{pump}\eta_m)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.21] Fans: $E=k_{cool}\dot Q_{reb}$, 0.015 {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.22] Compression: $E=6.4\,C/C_6$ MWe to 2,015 psia {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.23] Recycle row: $E_{pur}=5.7\,s(1+\Delta F_{slip}/1473)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.24] Total: $E_{tot}=E_{proc}+E_{circ}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.25] Primary flow depends on $\dot Q_R$, so B.9, B.10, B.13 and B.20 are coupled {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.26] Fixed point: iterate B.20 to $10^{-9}$ MW {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.27] Minimum capacity with corners {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.28] Heat basis sensitivity: replace J.14 by 143.4 MWth {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.29] Fixed rating: $E_{imp}=E_{nuc}-\max(0,\dot Q_{rated}-\dot Q_{heat})\eta_{pc}$. Unmet electrical demand {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.30] Pinch: stack grades against I.17, hot water loop excluded {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[J.31] Cooling: $\dot Q_{cool}=\dot Q_{KO}+\dot Q_{HW}+\dot Q_{lean}+\dot Q_{cond}+(1-\eta_{pc})\dot Q_{pc}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.32] Thermal efficiency: $\eta_{th}=\dot m_{H_2}LHV_{H_2}/(\dot n_{NG}LHV_{NG}+\dot Q_R)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.33] Capture: print $\eta_{pp}$ and $\eta_{pl}=C/F_C$ together {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.34] Yield: $\dot m_{H_2}/\dot m_{NG}$, and scf H2 per scf NG {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[J.35] Walk: 206.0, then purge, losses, circulators, MEA swap, reboiler gap {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[J.36] Comparison: rated 210 MWth against feasible 179.0 MWth, cost effect L.26 {\footnotesize [O]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section K}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[K.1] Baseline: $e_{base}=\dot E_{base,A}/\dot m_{H_2,A}$ from 3,205 st/d {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.2] Bounds: 9.35 Cho, 9.00 IEAGHG {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[K.3] Annual: $E_{base}=e_{base}M_{H_2}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.4] Furnace CO2: fired feed plus reject carbon times $M_{CO_2}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.5] Process minimum: $e_{st}=M_{CO_2}/(4M_{H_2})=5.46$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.6] Carbon bound: $e_{feed}=F_CM_{CO_2}/\dot m_{H_2}=5.97$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.7] Captured: $E_{cap}=CM_{CO_2}t_h$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.8] Residual: $E_{atm}=(1-f_r)GM_{CO_2}t_h$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.9] Electricity: $E_{el}=E_{imp}t_hEF_{grid}$, 0.402 t/MWh {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[K.10] Hours: $t_h=8760f_{av}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.11] Net abatement: $\mathcal A=E_{base}-E_{atm}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.12] Bounds: replace K.1 by K.2 {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.13] Intensity: $CI=E_{atm}/M_{H_2}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.14] Pair: K.11 printed with $\eta_{pp}$ and $\eta_{pl}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.15] Capture sensitivity: $\mathcal A(\eta_{pp})$ through J.8 {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[K.16] Availability: $\mathcal A\propto f_{av}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[K.17] Tail-gas fates: recycle, burn on site, export, each with atmosphere view. Exclusion by boundary never removes carbon {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[K.18] System view: $\mathcal A_{sys}=\mathcal A-E_{lost\,steam}+E_{base\,power}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[K.19] Lifecycle: add upstream gas 11.5 kg/GJ, less nuclear 5.5 kg/MWh, less T\&S 2.5\% {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[K.20] Backup firing: extra H2 in $(1-f_{av})$ hours at $e_{bk}=e_{site}+\dot Q_{proc}EF/(\eta_{bk}\dot m_{H_2})$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[K.21] Comparator: SMR plus CCS, new-build, same H2, one labelled row {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[K.22] Target test: $\mathcal A>0.25$ Mt/y {\footnotesize [R]}
\end{enumerate}
\paragraph{Section L}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.4cm,itemsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt]\small
\item[L.1] $CRF=i/[1-(1+i)^{-t_\ell}]$, from an annuity sum {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.2] Annualised capital: $C_{ann}=C\,CRF$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.3] Sinking fund: $SFF=i/[(1+i)^{t_\ell}-1]$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.4] IDC: $f_{IDC}=[(1+i)^{t_c}-1]/(it_c)$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.5] OCC: $c_{kWt}=c_{kWe}(1-0.09)\cdot0.40$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.6] Reactor: $C_R=c_{kWt}\dot Q_{ref}F_{19}m_{stage}(\dot Q_{rated}/\dot Q_{ref})^{n_s}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.7] Stage: BOAK 1.0, FOAK 1.6 (1.3 to 2.1) {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.8] Learning, route p46: $m=0.9^{\log_210}=0.7047$ from BOAK {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.9] Learning, route p47: $m=1.6\cdot0.7047=1.128$ from FOAK {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.10] Size exponent: 1.0; 0.6 [A]; $0.31=1+\ln(26553/18313)/\ln(350/600)$ [C] {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[L.11] Reactor O\&M: $C_{OM}=c_{OM}F_{19}t_h[f_{fuel}\dot Q+(1-f_{fuel})\dot Q_{ref}(\dot Q/\dot Q_{ref})^{n_s}]$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.12] Capture capital: $C_{cap}=K_{cap}\dot m_{CO_2}$, $K=2.04$ S\$M per t/h (1.74 to 5.09) {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.13] Capture fixed O\&M: $0.027C_{cap}$, 6\% high {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[L.14] Variable O\&M: MEA make-up unpriced central; reference chemicals EUR 0.1M/y {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[L.15] T\&S: $C_{TS}=p_{TS}E_{cap}$, 60 (23.2 to 112) {\footnotesize [F]}
\item[L.16] Gas saving: $C_{gas}=-(52.5s-34.0s)\,HHV\,d\,p_{gas}$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.17] Electricity: self-supplied, $C_{el}=E_{imp}t_hp_{el}$ only when importing {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.18] IHX: duty over 170 MW times S\$ anchor on CRF 25 {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[L.19] Licensing: US\$50M (0 to 137.5) on $CRF$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[L.20] Decommissioning: $1000(0.40\dot Q)FX\,SFF$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[L.21] IDC term: $C_R(f_{IDC}-1)CRF$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.22] Power island: US\$540/kWe on $E_{tot}$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.23] Recycle train: S\$71.5M at Case A, scaled by $s$ {\footnotesize [E]}
\item[L.24] Lost steam and baseline power, L5 {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.25] Incremental cost: $\Delta C=\sum$ ladder rung L0 to L5 {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.26] $AC=\Delta C/\mathcal A$ {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.27] Table: $n_s$ at 1.0, 0.6, 0.31 side by side, BOAK and FOAK, 25 y and 60 y {\footnotesize [R]}
\item[L.28] Levelised abatement cost: $LAC=\mathrm{NPV}(\Delta C)/\mathrm{NPV}(\mathcal A)$ {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.29] Sensitivity: one-at-a-time over gas, T\&S, $n_s$, stage, capital, availability {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.30] Discount sweep: 5, 8, 10\% through L.1, L.3, L.4 {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.31] Levers to S\$100/t: solve for single input {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.32] Comparator: SMR plus CCS row, same ladder {\footnotesize [O]}
\item[L.33] Guards: no double count of capture energy; FX 1.6195 and 2.322 factors; carbon tax printed apart {\footnotesize [F]}
\end{enumerate}
